title: CSS Modules
description: Learn scoped styling with CSS Modules to avoid class name conflicts.

data.text: **CSS Modules** provide locally scoped CSS by default. Class names are automatically generated to avoid conflicts between components.
Import a CSS file as a module and access class names as properties of the imported object.

data.content: Creating and using a CSS module

data.text: CSS Module class names are unique (e.g., `Button_primary_x7k2a`). This prevents style leaks between components.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: CSS Modules solve the global namespace problem in CSS.
